UI flows drive the delivered app on the workspace's **agent-keyed** origin -- `https://<label>.agent-<hex>.localhost:8431/`, where `mngr forward` serves it -- built from the agent id the driver already holds. The pre-auth session cookie the flow browser is armed with now carries the scope the proxy issues its own session at (`Domain=agent-<hex>.localhost`, path `/`, secure, `SameSite=None`), so it covers the workspace's whole origin family rather than the single label a flow opens on, and a flow that crosses labels stays authenticated instead of landing on the login page.

The workspace's mngr host id is no longer looked up for anything, so the `host_id_unknown` error reason is gone. An agent id the proxy does not route on is recorded as `workspace_unaddressable` instead: like the reason it replaces, it is an `error` (the harness cannot address the workspace) and never charged to the agent.
